# `ext::sparse_cg` — declaration reference

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../extended/ext/sparse_cg.lani#L4)

Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Bounded conjugate-gradient solver for canonical finite square CSR with explicit None/Jacobi preconditioning. Exact numerical symmetry and positive Jacobi diagonals are checked; positive definiteness remains a caller requirement. Solution owns independent x and distinguishes Converged from IterationLimit; reported residual is freshly recomputed initially and after every update. Recursive/fresh residual disagreement can restart. Full requested setup+iterations*step work is admitted before payload, five vectors plus optional Jacobi diagonal are bounded, and scratch/partial owners are released explicitly. Finite binary64 dot products can overflow or break down even for SPD inputs. Source 778d9d4f passes all six library gates across separate receipts: three accepted semantic/OOM tests in the mixed initial 10.96s command, a corrected admission-only pass in 6.27s, a 1,918-case independent Fraction-Gaussian/fresh-residual model in 6.78s and a 65,536-row manufactured system in 14.08s. The initial command also records a stale admission assertion failure, replaced by the narrow retry. Reached workspace denials total 27 with full-address/size releases. Four graph-diffusion application tests pass in 17.42s/154 process cases. Older sparse receipts retain their separate scopes and were not rerun. Executed profile is native Linux x86_64 CPU output from the GPU compiler, with no device execution, universal convergence/accuracy or formal-proof claim.
